comingLast.roast: the bar has one job now: keep him here until they hand it over
10 points from 5 holes - entirely gettable, famously not got
escape number: 5. holes remaining: 3. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
current run rate 1.2 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
needs 4 from 3 - his playing group has started the commentary
needs 6 points from his last 5 to hand the blue balls to Miller
the good news: 3 points saves him. the bad news: current form says 1.3 a hole
at 1.4 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
on 22 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
pace of 1.4 - the blue balls have started their walk to the bar
